notes: 13 web searches used; ksh.hu and berindex.hu fetches failed (hosts not resolvable in this session) — every figure is read from search-result extracts of the cited pages, hence verify: true. The KSH STADAT table 20.1.1.52 itself was not seen.

Method as hungary-2026-10/research/labour.json: KSH 2025 FEOR-08 full-time average gross (total earnings) × 1.084 × 0.9406; loaded = 12 × gross × 1.13 ÷ 1,728 h, no shift allowance (as instructed). The skilled/shop-floor grades in labour.json also deduct a sick-pay saving; that variant is printed in each fullyLoaded note.

FEOR codes: the task named ISCO-style codes 2141/2143/2144; in FEOR-08 2141 is an IT systems analyst. The FEOR-08 engineer used is 2118 Gépészmérnök; supervisor is 3212 (manufacturing supervisor), not 3161 / 1321; inspector is 3135 (quality-assurance technician), not 7330 / 3122.

Loaded HUF/h (book now → sourced): engineer 7,120.97 → 8,939.41 (+26%); technician 4,380 → 6,524.82 (+49%); supervisor 5,374 → 7,285.40 (+36%); inspector 4,607 → 5,814.05 (+26%). The book is low on all four. The labour.json proxy rates (6,881.31 incl. shift allowance) were HIGH for inspector and LOW for supervisor.
Not found: a FEOR-08 industrial / process engineer row, a 3119 technician row, a shop-floor minőségellenőr row, Randstad / Grafton / Trenkwalder / Adecco 2026 guide figures for these roles.
